title: Reproducing Deal and Razouk 1980: four ways to end an oxidation

sample.paper: Fairchild (111) silicon, one side chem-mechanically polished
n-type 0.2–0.3 Ω·cm on 2-inch wafers (TR-1 to TR-12); p-type 0.4–0.7 Ω·cm on 3-inch wafers (TR-13 to TR-24)
sample.ours: DOPING: n_type | p_type (recorded; no program reads it)
sample.note: The two types on one recipe differ by up to 2.5 × 10^11 cm^-2 in the tables; our program gives them the same value. Type goes with wafer size here.

sample.paper: Hot sulfuric acid, aqua regia, 10:1 water:HF, 2-propanol vapour
0.079 to 0.089 µm in every run: times were chosen to give one thickness at three temperatures
sample.ours: grown by the history: 300, 84 and 28 min at 900, 1000 and 1100 °C

sample.paper: 1 µm Al-4%Cu-2%Si, cold flash evaporated, 750 µm dots

history.paper: “cleaned in hot sulfuric acid, aqua regia, 10:1 DI water: hydrofluoric acid, and 2-propanol vapor”
history.ours: CLEAN: sulfuric_aqua_regia_HF on the sample; no operator reads it

history.paper: “The wafers were then loaded into an oxidation furnace in the appropriate ambient, oxidized for a given time”
Tables 4-1 and 4-2: dry O2 at 1000 °C for 84 min
history.ours: RUN Oxidation DURATION 5040 TEMP 1000->1000 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: The datasets' recipe for this wafer starts after the oxidation.

history.paper: “O2 FP = fast pull (<3 sec) in O2; O2 SP = slow pull (10 min) in O2; N2 SP or Ar SP = slow pull (2 min) in N2 or Ar”
history.ours: RUN Pull DURATION 3 TEMP 1000->400 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: The time is the paper's. The temperature path is ours: a straight fall to 400 °C, carried over from the 1967 paper's pull series.

history.paper: “1 µm thick Al-Cu-Si films were vacuum deposited on the oxides by cold flash (no substrate heating) in order to avoid radiation effects from e-beam evaporations”
“One half of each wafer was annealed at 400°C in nitrogen for 10 minutes while the other half was annealed in 10% H2 in N2 also at 400°C for 10 minutes.”
history.ours: RUN PostMetalAnneal DURATION 600 TEMP 400->400 AMBIENT inert_N2
history.note: Not in the datasets' recipe. The value compared here is the nitrogen half; the dataset also holds the hydrogen half.

history.item: 1 MHz and quasi-static C-V, before any injection
history.paper: “Values of Nf and Nit for each wafer were determined prior to avalanche injection”

cases.label: TR-5: n-type, 1000 °C, fast pull in oxygen

steps.name: Clean
steps.label: Acid clean, HF, propanol vapour
steps.paper: “cleaned in hot sulfuric acid, aqua regia, 10:1 DI water: hydrofluoric acid, and 2-propanol vapor”

steps.name: Load
steps.label: Loaded “in the appropriate ambient”
steps.paper: “The wafers were then loaded into an oxidation furnace in the appropriate ambient, oxidized for a given time”
steps.timing: Load gas, push rate and ramp are not given

steps.name: Oxidation
steps.label: Dry oxidation, 1000 °C, 84 min
steps.isl: RUN Oxidation DURATION 5040 TEMP 1000->1000 AMBIENT dry_O2
steps.paper: Tables 4-1 and 4-2: dry O2 at 1000 °C for 84 min
steps.timing: Ox/Anneal/Cool time column of the tables

steps.name: Pull
steps.label: Pull, under 3 s, in oxygen
steps.isl: RUN Pull DURATION 3 TEMP 1000->400 AMBIENT dry_O2
steps.paper: “O2 FP = fast pull (<3 sec) in O2; O2 SP = slow pull (10 min) in O2; N2 SP or Ar SP = slow pull (2 min) in N2 or Ar”
steps.timing: “<3 sec” in the table, “1-3 sec” in the text, 0 in the time column

steps.name: Metal
steps.label: Al-Cu-Si by cold flash evaporation
steps.paper: “1 µm thick Al-Cu-Si films were vacuum deposited on the oxides by cold flash (no substrate heating) in order to avoid radiation effects from e-beam evaporations”

steps.name: PostMetalAnneal
steps.label: After metal: 400 °C, 10 min, nitrogen (this half)
steps.isl: RUN PostMetalAnneal DURATION 600 TEMP 400->400 AMBIENT inert_N2
steps.paper: “One half of each wafer was annealed at 400°C in nitrogen for 10 minutes while the other half was annealed in 10% H2 in N2 also at 400°C for 10 minutes.”
steps.timing: 10 min

steps.name: CV
steps.label: 1 MHz and quasi-static C-V, before any injection
steps.paper: “Values of Nf and Nit for each wafer were determined prior to avalanche injection”

steps.label: Al-Cu-Si by cold flash evaporation
steps.paper: “1 µm thick Al-Cu-Si films were vacuum deposited on the oxides by cold flash (no substrate heating) in order to avoid radiation effects from e-beam evaporations”

steps.name: PostMetalAnneal
steps.label: After metal: 400 °C, 10 min, nitrogen (this half)
steps.isl: RUN PostMetalAnneal DURATION 600 TEMP 400->400 AMBIENT inert_N2
steps.paper: “One half of each wafer was annealed at 400°C in nitrogen for 10 minutes while the other half was annealed in 10% H2 in N2 also at 400°C for 10 minutes.”
steps.timing: 10 min

steps.name: CV

steps.paper: “Values of Nf and Nit for each wafer were determined prior to avalanche injection”
